transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I came in today because... well, I keep hearing voices. It's as clear as somebody standing right there in my little studio with me. They keep saying my name and telling me that my work is being judged. But the house is completely quiet, and I know nobody else is there. It's just really bothering me, and I needed to see someone about it.
How long have you been experiencing these voices?
It's been about nine months now. The voices, and... and just this constant fear I have that my work is being watched all the time. It's all been going on for about nine months.
During these past nine months, have you experienced any periods where your mood felt extremely low or, conversely, unusually high or energetic?

Yes, I have. I get these times where I just feel... so bright and chosen. It's like I have all this energy and Greenville just can't hold all the plans I have in my head. But it doesn't always stay a good feeling. I'll go right from feeling that way to snapping hard at someone over a really small thing. Like at work, if one of my clients just asks me to repeat myself, I'll just snap right at them. It goes back and forth from having all those big plans to just being so irritable.
Are there times when your mood feels completely normal, yet you still hear the voices and feel like you are being watched?

Yeah, there are. Actually, there was a time not too long ago... my energy had finally dropped back down, and I was sleeping more normally again. I didn't feel all over the place. But even though my mood felt fine, the voices didn't stop. And that belief I have that people are tracking my work and judging me... that kept going for several weeks, even when I was feeling totally normal otherwise.
During those times when you felt 'bright and chosen' with lots of energy and big plans, did you ever find that you didn't need to sleep for days at a time and still felt completely rested?

Yes, that's exactly how it is. I've gone many nights where I sleep for maybe two or three hours at most. But then I'll get up feeling completely charged... like I just had a full night's rest. I don't feel tired at all, I just get right up and go straight back to painting or making calls.
